speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: The Ministry of Transport (MOT) will strengthen Singapore's position as a global sustainable aviation and maritime hub and increase transportation options for Singaporeans to meet future mobility needs.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: MOT will continue to expand international linkages in air, sea and land transport through stronger international cooperation and strategic agreements with key partners.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: This will enhance Singapore's role as a trusted node in the global supply chain and a vital connector between Asia and the world, while expanding opportunities for businesses and creating good jobs for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: Changi Terminal 5 (T5) will bolster Singapore's air connectivity and reinforce Changi's position as a leading global air hub.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: We will also develop the Changi East Urban District, a new lifestyle and business hub located at the doorstep of T5, that will offer new spaces for Singaporeans and visitors to connect, work and play.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: Ahead of T5’s opening, MOT will work with tripartite partners to uplift aviation careers, through jobs transformation, skills upgrading and adoption of technology such as autonomous airside vehicles and artificial intelligence (AI) to optimise operations.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: Our air hub will also become more sustainable with the use of sustainable aviation fuel.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: The Port of Singapore, one of the world’s busiest container ports, will expand further.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: The consolidation of port facilities at Tuas will free up land in the city centre for urban development and green spaces that Singaporeans can enjoy.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: As the maritime industry decarbonises, MOT will also build expertise and infrastructure to handle alternative fuels at scale, so that our port remains ready for a low-carbon future.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: The RTS link will serve the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone and strengthen economic and people ties between Singapore and Malaysia.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: Under the Land Transport Master Plan, MOT will continue to expand our rail network.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: In the coming years, we will close the loop for the Circle Line, extend the Downtown Line and Thomson-East Coast Line and progressively open the new Jurong Region Line (JRL).

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: The Cross Island Line will link all existing lines when it is completed, providing an alternative route during planned maintenance and in the event of disruption.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: The next bound of rail expansion in the late 2030s and early 2040s will include JRL’s West Coast Extension and the Seletar and Tengah lines.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: Maintaining high rail reliability standards will remain a key challenge as our network grows and ages.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: MOT will work with rail operators and workers to invest in systems and training to improve monitoring, maintenance and renewal of our railway assets.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: We will enhance bus connectivity to meet ridership demand in newly-developed residential towns.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) will improve first- and last-mile connectivity and help ease manpower and land constraints for public transport.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: Autonomous mobility will create good jobs in areas such as remote or safety operators, software developers, engineers and radar designers.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: As Singapore continues to develop and our society evolves, MOT will listen and engage the public to better understand these changing needs and to build a land transport system that Singaporeans can take pride in.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: We will continue to upgrade MRT stations and bus interchanges for easier navigation and to make them more welcoming spaces.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: We are retrofitting lifts at pedestrian overhead bridges and implementing features like covered linkways, kerbless crossings, and wider footpaths.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
text: MOT will continue to develop a transport system that strengthens Singapore’s position as a global hub through growing our air, maritime and land connectivity, and building a transport network that connects lives and livelihoods for Singaporeans.
